rules.H-main: Ours today (#765): a block above L that starts below a short Quote's top moves the Quote's rounded overflow (1 at 520 px, 3 at 600 px), whatever its kind or height.
rules.H-kind: Only Shapes move there: a Line or a Button above L from below the top stays (v3a).
rules.H-height: Only blocks 2 or more rows tall move there: a 1-row block stays, whatever its kind (v3a).
rules.H-one: A block above L from below the top moves 1, not the overflow (v4a).
rules.H-prop: It moves its share of the overflow, round(over * (bottom - top of Quote) / (L - top of Quote)): v4a's 3-to-5 Shape would move 2, so v4a already refutes it at 600 px; listed to be sure for rows 2 to 6.
rules.H-quote: x5: the Quote sets d and L even when a written Text in the group runs over more.

x5 next.H-quote: the Quote grows its own rows and the Text grows as a block across L; the Shape moves the Quote's rounded overflow

note: Areas are desktop areas in the read's block order (x5: the Text first, then the Quote, then the Shape). Dropped areas are ours; a drop that lands elsewhere is scored on whether each block grew, moved (and by how much) or stayed.
